== Biography ==

The same 1911 Gortereghy census browse records Neal Anderson, aged 65, with Abraham Anderson, aged 60, and Robert Anderson, aged 50, each identified as brothers within the household. It is relevant as Fan context because Robert Anderson appears as a witness in the 1908 Elder marriage transcription and the Anderson surname also occurs in the Elder marriage network.<ref>Down the Road, Gortereghy 1911 census browse; [https://downtheroad.dev/de/census?county=Antrim&tab=browse&townland=Gortereghy&year=1911 record].</ref> It does not establish a relationship to Alexander Glasgow or to the Glasgow family.

The same reproduced Second Portglenone Presbyterian marriage list records Neal Anderson, full-age bachelor farmer of Gortreaghy, marrying Sarah Elder, full-age spinster of Gortreaghy, on 28 September 1893. Sarah's father is recorded as Robert Elder, farmer; witnesses were Robert Anderson and Nancy Elder.<ref>RootsChat, Elder, Murdoch & McMeekin Families; [https://www.rootschat.com/forum/index.php?topic=214109.0 record].</ref> This is a new parent-bearing record for the Gortreaghy Elder household and is consistent with the 1908 entry naming Alexander Elder as a son of a Robert Elder, but the shared father's identity and any connection to Robert Elder, husband of Mary Glasgow, remain unproved until the original register is inspected.
